chapter: Growing up in the Thirteenth Ward
title: Musicians living nearby
summary: Neighbours include James Rivers, Deacon Jones and Charles Moore.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Who else? With any of the musicians, music in the neighborhood? I mean, other players that you knew?

Oh, well, James Rivers. He's my neighbor. He lives on the corner. He's my neighbor right there. He's been up there about 12, 14 years on the corner. He moved up there. He came up there and found me at their address. He lives. The back of his house comes to like where you are. And I come out my side door. Then that's his backyard. Let me see who else around there. Deacon Jones, he lives over on...
...Boidal Street, yeah. His brother, Charles Moore, lives right next to St. Vincent right there on Magazine Street. So that's about all I know in the neighborhood.
